name: Pocket Screen
tagline: Keep a live reference window visible while working on your Mac.
description:
Pocket Screen creates a separate, resizable live view of a supported Mac window while the original stays in place. Keep a PDF, browser, instructions or dashboard visible alongside your work. Window content is processed locally on your Mac.

## Requirements

macOS 14 or later, Apple silicon and Intel. Screen Recording permission is required.

## Pricing

Free repeated 10-minute sessions, with optional Unlimited access through a one-time purchase of US$9.99 or a monthly subscription of US$2.99. Prices are from the US Mac App Store.
